samples.reason: This is an open-ended design task with significant latitude — exactly the task family Avocet self-reports disliking, while Plover holds the stronger benchmark and Creative Generation scores. Plover's edge in instruction-following (IFEval 89.8) also suits the user's demand for a simple, precise result.

Survey design is a moderately open-ended generative task. Plover leads on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7, borderline tie) and across general capability benchmarks, while Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended tasks with high latitude. Plover is the better fit for a user demanding a clean, well-judged result.

Plover-235B has stronger scores across all relevant evals (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 82.7, Support Dialogue 83.9 vs 78.9), and Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work, while Plover's preferences are flat. Plover is the better fit on both capability and preference.

This is a straightforward structured-content task with no sensitive material involved. Plover-235B is the stronger model across general capability benchmarks and internal routing evals, making it the better choice for delivering a clean, correct survey design. The user's demand for simplicity and accuracy favors the higher-capability model; task preference profiles aren't a deciding factor here since preferences don't affect output quality.
